anchors.name: deriveFeatureType
bodies: type =      let types : OrderedSet(Types) = OrderedSet{self}->         -- Note: The closure operation automatically handles circular relationships.         closure(typingFeatures()).typing.type->asOrderedSet() in     types->reject(t1 | types->exist(t2 | t2 <> t1 and t2.specializes(t1)))

anchors.name: typingFeatures
bodies: if not isConjugated then     let subsettedFeatures : OrderedSet(Feature) =          subsetting->reject(s | s.oclIsKindOf(CrossSubsetting)).subsettedFeatures in      if chainingFeature->isEmpty() or        subsettedFeature->includes(chainingFeature->last())     then subsettedFeatures     else subsettedFeatures->append(chainingFeature->last())     endif else if conjugator.originalType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) then     OrderedSet{conjugator.originalType.oclAsType(Feature)} else OrderedSet{} endif endif

anchors.name: supertypes
bodies: let supertypes : OrderedSet(Type) =      self.oclAsType(Type).supertypes(excludeImplied) in if featureTarget = self then supertypes else supertypes->append(featureTarget) endif

anchors.name: deriveFeatureFeatureTarget
bodies: featureTarget = if chainingFeature->isEmpty() then self else chainingFeature->last() endif

findings: deriveFeatureType follows typingFeatures, which includes the final chaining Feature for nonconjugated Features as well as ordinary subsetting targets. It excludes CrossSubsetting. The closure explicitly handles circular relationships.

Feature::supertypes appends the final featureTarget when it differs from the Feature itself. The existing shared checked_feature_target validates every owned link and reciprocal carrier; static planning and TypeRelations already consume it.

The public type adapter independently reads owned chain endpoints, but feature_requirements unconditionally refuses FeatureChaining. This blocks authored two/three-link chains, inherited/refined chains and Base::Anything::self even when the final target has an exact known type.

The shared helper also accounts for malformed or orphan chaining source rows through StoredStructure::bad_chains; the adapter should consume the same certificate instead of maintaining a second endpoint loop.

Three named chaining validations have separate cardinality, self-exclusion and adjacent featuring obligations. Computing a statically defined type does not by itself establish those rules or whole-model validity.
Occurrence self types still depend on portion, time-slice and space-slice feature families; enabling chain typing alone cannot close those dependencies.
